title: Rice Brown Spot (Bipolaris oryzae)
content:
Brown spot is caused by Bipolaris oryzae (Helminthosporium oryzae). It is strongly associated with nutrient-deficient soils, particularly low potassium and silicon.

Symptoms: Oval to round brown spots on leaves, often with a yellow halo. Spots can coalesce, causing leaf drying. On grains, black discoloration at the embryo end (pecky rice).

Favorable conditions: Poor soil fertility, especially potassium deficiency. High relative humidity (85%+). Temperatures 25-33°C. Water stress or drought predisposes plants.

Management: Soil testing and balanced fertilization are critical. Apply potash (MOP) at 40-60 kg/ha if soil potassium is low. Silicon application (calcium silicate 200 kg/ha) reduces severity. Seed treatment with carbendazim 2g/kg seed. Foliar spray of mancozeb 2.5g/L at disease onset. Always verify dosage with your local KVK.
content_hi:
भूरा धब्बा रोग Bipolaris oryzae से होता है। यह पोषक तत्वों की कमी वाली मिट्टी, विशेषकर पोटाश की कमी से जुड़ा है।

लक्षण: पत्तियों पर अंडाकार भूरे धब्बे, पीले घेरे के साथ। दानों पर काला रंग।

प्रबंधन: मिट्टी परीक्षण करवाएं। पोटाश उर्वरक का प्रयोग करें। सिलिकॉन का प्रयोग लाभदायक है।
summary: Brown spot is a fungal disease of rice linked to potassium-deficient soils. Produces oval brown leaf spots with yellow halos.
summary_hi: भूरा धब्बा धान का एक फफूंद जनित रोग है जो पोटाश की कमी वाली मिट्टी में होता है। पत्तियों पर पीले घेरे वाले भूरे धब्बे बनते हैं।
actions: Get your soil tested at the nearest Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) or Soil Testing Lab to check potassium levels.
Apply Muriate of Potash (MOP) at the rate recommended by your soil test report (typically 40-60 kg/ha for deficient soils).
Apply calcium silicate at 200 kg/ha if available — silica strengthens rice against brown spot.
For seed treatment in the next season: treat seeds with carbendazim 2g per kg of seed before sowing.
Ensure proper water management — alternate wetting and drying reduces disease pressure better than continuous flooding.
warnings: Brown spot symptoms overlap with blast. Check: brown spot lesions are oval with yellow halo; blast lesions are diamond-shaped with gray center.
Do NOT skip soil testing — applying fertilizers without knowing soil nutrient status can worsen the problem.
